title: Consume pantheon-base-v0.16.1 into pantheon-ops
goal: Advance the Ops foundation consumer from the stale pantheon-base-v0.13.0 baseline to the published pantheon-base-v0.16.1 release, materialize and verify the immutable assets, swap the ops baseline to the rebuilt assembly, and prove the business overlay still assembles and runs on the new base.

in: Update foundation-release.lock.json to pantheon-base-v0.16.1: release line, base commit, asset name, bundle checksum, repo.tar checksum and local materialization path.
Materialize the release under .foundation/releases/pantheon-base-v0.16.1/ and verify both SHA-256 digests against the published sidecars and the GitHub asset digests.
Rebuild the full Ops tree from the locked release snapshot through scripts/business-overlay/rebuild-from-base.mjs.
Declare .foundation as an ops-owned repository overlay so the drift allowlist and release ledger survive a baseline swap.
Replace the ops baseline with the verified rebuilt assembly and re-run the overlay, drift, backend and frontend gates.
Repair the two base-compatibility defects the rebuild exposed: the overlay menu registry package name and the untidied merged module graph in the hosted compatibility job.
Record harness evidence, the release ledger entry and the consumer pre-flight for the lock update.
out: Any change to the pantheon-base repository, to an existing immutable release, or to the v0.16.1 asset set.
Creating a new base release that would include the 13 post-tag commits on base main.
Any change to business module behaviour, routes, permissions, menus, i18n or migrations.
Pushing the upgraded branch to origin, or merging the divergent remote main line.

implementationNotes: v0.14.0, v0.15.0 and v0.16.0 were published with zero assets, so no lock could be advanced for them; v0.16.1 is the first release after v0.13.0 that carries foundation-release-pantheon-base-v0.16.1.tgz, its .sha256 sidecar, repo.tar and repo.tar.sha256.

The lock is consumed by rebuild-from-base.mjs and check-shared-drift.mjs from the repository root; .foundation/foundation-release.lock.json is the inheritance ledger and previously described a v0.13.1 release that was never published.
sharedPaths is byte-identical across the v0.13.0 lock, the v0.13.0 manifest and the v0.16.1 manifest (52 entries: backend 4, frontend 46, docs 2), so only version, commit and digests moved.
The release snapshot is the tag tree c83f8e4c, which is 13 commits behind base main. Post-release base commits reach ops through the next published release, not by consuming base main.

rebuild-from-base.mjs derives the overlay menu registry package from the copied base directory; base v0.16.0 renamed that directory to package menu, so the hardcoded package iam broke every rebuild from 2026-09-14 onward.
The merged go.mod only carries Base's indirect requirement block, so the rebuilt backend needs go mod tidy before it compiles; the hosted Base Compatibility Rebuild now runs that step explicitly.

doNotTouch: any existing tag, release, or previously materialized .foundation/releases/* entry

deferredCodeIssues: base main is 13 commits ahead of the v0.16.1 release tag
local cgo toolchain cannot build sqlite-backed base packages

designGate: inheritance boundary note: base owns platform/system, ops consumes an immutable release snapshot
developmentGate: rebuilt tree verified before the baseline swap
qaAcceptanceGate: business-overlay contract and drift hash check
backend build/vet/test on the rebuilt module graph
frontend type-check on the rebuilt tree

affectedSubgraph: foundation release -> consumer lock -> rebuilt tree -> business overlay anchors -> backend/frontend gates
riskNodes: shared prefix of the ops tree

runtimeEvidence: shared-drift hash comparison against the materialized v0.16.1 snapshot
overlay contract resolution on the rebuilt tree
backend build/vet/test on the rebuilt module graph
frontend type-check on the rebuilt tree

evidenceRequired: release identity and verified SHA-256 digests
sharedPaths equivalence across lock and manifests
overlay anchor and drift results on the rebuilt tree
completionChecklist: Baseline swap verified through staged gates
